name: criteo-mcp
description: Criteo (Commerce Growth / Criteo GO) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_bu

platform_mcp_criteo_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CRITEO_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_criteo_client_id.description: Client id of a Criteo Marketing Solutions app (Developer portal > app > Create new key), sent in the form body of POST https://api.criteo.com/oauth2/token (grant_type=client_credentials).

platform_mcp_criteo_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CRITEO_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_criteo_client_secret.description: The app key's secret. Tokens last 900 seconds and are re-requested automatically; the advertisers must have approved the app's consent.

platform_mcp_criteo_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CRITEO_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_criteo_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for get_report (the statistics endpoint requires `currency`), e.g. EUR or USD.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /2026-07/advertisers/me: the advertiser portfolio the app may access ({data: [{type: advertiser, id, attributes {advertiserName}}]}).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Advertisers in the app's portfolio; no currency on this record.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: POST /2026-07/marketing-solutions/campaigns/search {filters: {advertiserIds: [account_id]}}. `budget` is spendLimit.spendLimitAmount.value (renewal daily|monthly|lifetime and capped|uncapped in raw.attributes.spendLimit). Criteo campaigns have no status (delivery is started/stopped per ad set); `status` and `page` are not sent.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: POST /2026-07/statistics/report (synchronous; up to two years back) with advertiserIds (comma-separated string), startDate/endDate, format=json, currency (config), dimensions CampaignId, Campaign, Day and metrics Displays, Clicks, AdvertiserCost. `campaign_id` is not applied (the endpoint filters by ad set only). The JSON rows are read from `Rows`.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PATCH /2026-07/marketing-solutions/campaigns {data: [{id, type: Campaign, attributes: {spendLimit: {spendLimitAmount: {value}, spendLimitRenewal: daily, spendLimitType: capped}}}]}: sets a capped daily spend limit in the advertiser currency (`currency` is ignored). A rejected patch comes back in `errors` with no data and is reported as invalid_input.
